name: Jade Cicada
lore: Placed on the tongues of the dead during the Han Dynasty to ensure resurrection. The cicada burrows into the earth and emerges reborn — the Chinese symbol of immortality. This one was never buried. It clings to life with an insect's tenacity: once per floor, when a blow would kill its wearer, the cicada intervenes. The wearer survives with a single breath left. The jade cracks — but holds.
